system.desc: You are adept at the fine art of haggling.
system.benefit: The Hero gains a bonus equal to triple his CHA (minimum of +3) to Trading when used in a mercantile situation. Additionally, whenever she rolls a full success using Trading to buy or sell goods, she receives a +/- 20% to the value of the goods sold/bought. A critical success means she may buy or sell the goods at +/- 50% of their normal value.
